neighbours.label: A plural noun naming a set of alternative abstract variants (theories, approaches, models, implementations, ways, interpretations) and the preposition after it; concrete plurals and a single item are quiet
fire: The lecture surveys four rival theories of how language evolved and weighs the evidence for each.
Engineers tried several approaches to cooling the reactor before they found one that worked.
Astronomers have put forward two models of how the rings of Saturn formed.
The package offers three implementations of the hashing function.
There are a number of different ways to prove this theorem. The shortest uses induction.
Scholars still argue over the competing explanations of why the empire collapsed.
The handbook describes five main styles of leadership and when each is useful.
Philosophers distinguish several conceptions of justice that often pull against each other.
quiet: The lecture surveys the long history of how the city grew and shows many old photographs.
Engineers carried several buckets of water to the reactor before the pumps were repaired.
Astronomers have bought two telescopes for the new observatory on the hill.
The package weighs three kilograms with the batteries inside.
There is a narrow path to the top of this hill. The climb takes an hour.
Villagers still talk about the terrible winter when the river froze.
The cupboard held five large bottles of olive oil and a sack of rice.
Philosophers gathered in a small room that looked out over the harbour.

notes: Card: 'four major theories [of]', 'two versions [of]', 'implementations', class names 'Back[ends]', 'View[ers]'; promotes ' type', ' types', ' differ'.
